subject.title: [Bug]: OpenAI-compatible streaming tool calls are dropped when provider omits finish_reason

question: Should OpenClaw execute native OpenAI-compatible streamed tool calls when the stream ends with raw SSE `[DONE]` but no final `finish_reason`?
rationale: The code change would intentionally widen the provider-output-to-tool-execution boundary, and that contract choice cannot be settled by source inspection alone.

options.title: Accept clean-DONE tool execution
options.body: Land the candidate PR if maintainers accept raw SSE `[DONE]` plus native tool-call deltas as a safe terminal signal without `finish_reason`.

options.title: Require exact-provider proof
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until a redacted Evolink or equivalent live provider run proves the same path after the patch.

options.title: Keep finish_reason required
options.body: Reject the candidate fix and keep no-finish streamed tool calls fail-closed even when tool-call deltas were parsed.

recommendation.title: Accept clean-DONE tool execution
recommendation.body: Land the candidate PR if maintainers accept raw SSE `[DONE]` plus native tool-call deltas as a safe terminal signal without `finish_reason`.

likelyOwner.reason: He reviewed and merged the adjacent stop-finished tool-call contract and is the clearest history-backed owner for this boundary decision.
